_note: Canonical pi-cli models.json for Vertex AI. Committed to the repo so cloud dispatches succeed from environments without a workstation-configured ~/.pi/agent/models.json. metaproc.cloud.gcp.batch_backend.build_pi_models_json reads this as a fallback and rewrites the project ID in baseUrl at dispatch time.
_source: The vertex-maas catalog is maintained from public Vertex AI model metadata. The google-vertex provider uses pi-mono's native `google-vertex` API so Gemini thought-signature round trips are preserved; see the adapter compatibility runbook.

vertex-maas.apiKey: !sh -c 'if [ -n "$METAPROC_PI_API_KEY" ]; then printf "%s" "$METAPROC_PI_API_KEY"; else exec gcp-access-token.sh; fi'

openai._note: OpenAI API public catalog — current tiers only. Flagship is gpt-5.5 (released 2026-04-23, API 2026-04-24). gpt-5.5-pro is the high-compute reasoning variant. gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-5.4-nano remain the current cost-optimized tiers (gpt-5.5-mini is projected for Q3 2026). Older gpt-5.x and o-series IDs (gpt-5.2, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-pro, o3, o4-mini) were trimmed per `only support latest OpenAI`; restore from git history if a historical run requires re-validation.

deepseek._note: DeepSeek first-party API (V4 family). OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions. V4 released 2026-04-24; both IDs support 1M context and dual mode (thinking / non-thinking) on the same model ID. The deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner V3.2 aliases retire 2026-07-24 and are no longer registered here — use deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro.

moonshot._note: Moonshot first-party API (Kimi K2.6). OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions at api.moonshot.ai. K2.6 GA April 2026; multimodal (text + image), 262K context, 1T-parameter MoE. Vertex MaaS still ships only kimi-k2-thinking-maas — keep that entry in the vertex-maas block for the older agentic variant.
